# MD View 1.0.0-rc.6

The sixth public release candidate of MD View: a native Markdown, text, and code editor for
Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Rust and egui. No webview.

## Highlights

- **Spreadsheet grid for CSV and TSV.** `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.tab`, `.psv`, `.dsv`, and `.ssv` files
  open in an Excel-style grid. The delimiter and CRLF endings are detected. Type over a cell, or
  press Enter, F2, or double-click to edit; copy and paste blocks with Excel, LibreOffice, and
  Google Sheets; insert and delete rows and columns; resize columns. The grid edits the file's
  own text with minimal changes, so untouched fields keep their quoting, and undo, save, and
  Split view (text and grid side by side) work as for any document.
- **PDF viewer.** Continuous pages, fit-width or manual zoom, and page navigation, rendered in the
  background by hayro, a pure-Rust rasterizer, only near what you are looking at.
- **Video viewer.** MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, and every other format the system FFmpeg reads play
  with play/pause, a seek bar, ±5 s on the arrow keys, and mute. Without FFmpeg the viewer shows
  how to install it.
- **Animated images.** GIF, WebP, and APNG play with their own frame delays in the image viewer
  and the Markdown preview.
- **More image formats.** ICO/CUR, TGA, Radiance HDR, OpenEXR, PNM (PBM/PGM/PPM/PAM), QOI,
  Farbfeld, and JPEG XL, all decoded in pure Rust.
- **Richer animated SVG.** Motion along paths (`animateMotion`, `mpath`, `rotate="auto"`), line
  drawing with `stroke-dashoffset`, `fill="freeze"`, `keySplines` easing, and in CSS the delay,
  iteration count, `alternate`, fill mode, and timing functions. Timing now matches browsers.
- **Formula editor fix.** Pointing at `\frac` in the source highlights the whole fraction.
- **Sample files.** `examples/v1-workspace/media` has a file for every viewer, with a checklist.

Everything from the earlier candidates is included:

- **Equation gallery and formula editor (rc.5).** Σ gallery, √x editor with live preview,
  template palette, source-to-formula hover, and double-click editing.
- **System clipboard (rc.4)** and **editor behavior and the Markdown formatting bar (rc.3).**
- **From the earlier candidates:** split view with exact sync, GitHub Markdown parity, Oniguruma
  highlighting, CJK text, large files, the explorer that follows tabs, and the desktop packages.

## Install

Download the asset for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`:

| Platform | Preferred asset |
|---|---|
| Linux | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.6-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `mdview_1.0.0.rc.6_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora / RPM | `mdview-1.0.0.rc.6-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.6-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.6-windows-x86_64.msi` |

Video playback needs FFmpeg installed (`ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`, and `ffplay` for sound); everything
else is built in. The macOS and Windows RC builds are **unsigned**. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen may
ask for an extra confirmation. Signing and notarization remain final 1.0.0 release-operator steps.

Documentation: https://jigonzalez930209.github.io/md-view-rs/

## Checksums and SBOM

The release includes a combined `SHA256SUMS`, `latest.json`, and `sbom.cdx.json`. Use
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` on Linux/macOS or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.

Full changelog: https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/md-view-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
